rationale: The fix adds ValueError to a pre-existing except clause around the Pushover validate call (empty API response); the commit only added the unique_id reset, which the fix leaves untouched (the link comes from a test function signature).

The fix adds a new close_stale_connections() call that arrives with the PySwitchbot 0.19.3 bump, for an issue reported before this commit; the commit's added `or await switchbot.get_device(address)` stays unchanged and the link comes only from the version-pin lines.

The fix repairs the editable-install package-name check that a different commit introduced; on this commit's lines it only swaps the pre-existing logger.info for print so the message shows up, keeping the added version strings.

The linked change adds a new all_silo_model decorator and a special-case model list (described as experimental) and drops the already-decorated filter as part of that; the commit's rename of the attribute to silo_limit was not wrong.

The fix is a clean-up that deletes the removed `--force` option from printed help text; `--force` was already in the old lines and the commit only inserted the `setup` subcommand, which the fix keeps.

The follow-up commit from the same pull request, self-described as an optimization, extends the early return to None, which did not crash before (str(None) is not empty); the commit's empty-string check was correct.

The commit is a preparatory extraction of existing logic into _create_missing_fk_index (the blamed lines were only re-wrapped); the fix repairs the older FK-index detection logic of ticket #31335 and adds new remove_constraint/remove_index hooks.

The commit runs the shell builtin `command -v srun` through subprocess without a shell and catches only FileNotFoundError, so it raises PermissionError on some platforms; the fix replaces it with shutil.which.

The commit hard-coded 'lightning-app' (and 'lightning_app' for the repo-name check) in the editable-install detection, which does not match the egg-info directory that actually exists, so the function returned early and the local Lightning source was never packaged; the fix restores 'lightning' as the default.

The commit builds all_codes with dtype=np.int8, which wraps around once a categorical has more than 128 categories and corrupts take_codes; the bug-fix PR removes the int8 dtype from that line (its headline category-reordering bug lies in older code).

The commit switched recordings to fragmented MP4 with only the frag_keyframe flag, which some players fail to play back; the fix adds empty_moov on the same movflags line and names this commit as the cause.

The fix lowers the pre-existing 50 Hz steering send rate to 10 Hz while inactive and only hoists the commit's counter-init condition into a variable for reuse; it corrects nothing in the counter logic the commit added.

A test-helper validation PR adds a `last_org is not None` guard to the commit's features.has call, which the commit made with a possibly-None organization; the bundle does not show whether that call ever misbehaved or whether the guard only satisfies the stricter test check.

The fix repairs transaction filtering in other files and, to support it, adds tags[transaction] to the where-column allowlist; the commit deliberately allowed only environment and raised otherwise, and transaction filters were not passed through before it either.

The commit sets bs = len(dataset) for LoadImages as well, where len is the number of files rather than a batch size of 1, which breaks warmup on fixed-batch backends such as TensorRT; the fix restores bs = 1 in this file.
